title: Warn when the agent's model has under 64K context
description: Fabio 2026-09-24: the agent needs room to grow; floor 64K (lowered from 120K because local Ollama cannot hold 120K). Test tool use (the agent probe, MpiLlmSettings) reports the model's context window and warns under 64K; the probe can use _contextWindowFor. Compaction already follows the window (_compactAt: 50% below 1M, 30% at 1M+), so 64K compacts at 32K. Decision left: local Ollama runs at OLLAMA_AGENT_CONTEXT = 32K on purpose (KV cache shares VRAM with the weights), so it still warns unless that constant moves to 64K - an 8B model's fp16 KV cache is ~9.4 GB at 64K, tight on a 16 GB card.
